nom: COSRX Vitamin E Vitalizing Sunscreen SPF 50+

avis.titre: This sunscreen did not protect my skin.
avis.texte: I almost never write reviews, but I'm honestly so shocked by what happened that I felt I needed to warn others. I've worn sunscreen every single day for years and consistently use reliable, high-protection SPFs, so my face normally gets virtually no direct sun exposure or tanning. I decided to try this COSRX SPF 50+ and applied a generous amount evenly to my entire face, about an hour before going outside. I spent only around 30 minutes in the sun — and my face ended up SUNBURNED. I genuinely cannot remember the last time I had a sunburn on my face because I am extremely consistent and careful with sun protection. Korean sunscreens and skincare generally have such a strong reputation that having something like this happen with a product labeled SPF 50+ was the last thing I expected. I understand that everyone's experience can be different, but based on what happened to me, I absolutely would not trust this sunscreen to protect my skin from actual sun exposure. I'm writing this review because I wish I had known before relying on it. Please be careful.

this caused me to get milia around my t-zone! i have normal-slightly oily skin and tend to break out easily. definitely a no go for me for that reason alone. also if i apply my usual amount (2 finger-long strips), it looks and feels really greasy. 2 stars because it did prevent sunburn and it did blend invisibly.

This is my favorite sunscreen!! I use it as a moisturizer over my toner and serums in the morning and it pairs so well under makeup. I use the merit beauty complexion stick and it doesn't pill. This sunscreen is so lightweight, but hydrating. I love the vitamin e and I've noticed my acne scars fading! It's such a great product!!
Love this product! Ive tried so many sunscreens. Theyre either too oily, white cast or dry. This ones literally perf

avis.titre: I love it for me; notes for others
avis.texte: • For me this sunscreen works great! I have acne prone skin, and experience cystic acne as well, but this hasnt cause any trouble! • I do notice a bit of a white cast for abt 5 minutes after application. Im really pale, and its quite noticeable for that duration, so I think this would cause issues for those who arent •the formula is pretty thick! i dont mind it, but if youre looking for something more lightweight I dont think this would be the best product •It wears really well under my makeup! I use infallible concealor and fit me loose powder, and have had no issues at all. •there is definitely a fragrance, similar to other sunscreens ive tried! •it does burn if it gets in your eyes, but i dont have frequent problems with it "running" like other sunscreens ive tried. if your eyes water, you rub your eyes, or are too liberal with product application to begin with be careful!
As someone with dry skin, this sunscreen is very hydrating and leaves my skin with a glassy appearance. 100% recommend

I use this for about two months and I noticed my acne prone skin was breaking out from this sunscreen. It is quite oily compared to my other Korean sunscreens. I would not recommend this one. Also have a very strong sweet scent.
Hands-down, one of the best sunscreens on the market if you don't like that white kiss but wanna get extreme coverage and it's 50 SPF here's your go to Thank me later
This product has the worst chemically scent. It makes it completely unusuable.
I have combinaiton skin. This stuff is great for my skin ! Its moisturizing and thick. Leaves a glowy finish.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again.
avis.texte: I love the feeling of this lotion & love that it has such a high SPF.

This sunblock goes on smoothly. It doesn't get flaky once applied over my facial moisturizers. There's no chalky look on my face. I haven't gotten sunburnt while wearing during my walks/hikes. This is my second time buying. I waited until it was on sale.

It quite literally smelled like a perfume and they put perfume in the sunscreen that is supposed to be meant for your face. Not a very smart decision at all, and as a person with sensitive skin it gave me anxiety because I was worried my skin would react terribly to the perfume, so I had to return immediately. I do not recommend this to anyone. It was hydrating, gave a nice glow, and sat well under makeup but the smell was such a deal-breaker, it was not worth compromising my skin health for it.

I tried the supergoop, the naked sunday, and the cetaphil, rhis one was my favorite. The tink and textures of the others made them not as great. This one i wish was tonted but the fact that it blends well, is moisturizing, and best bang for my buck makes this one a winner

i have notoriously dry skin and spf's can be super drying for me, this one was not. it leaves me dewy and feeling fresh only con is that it smells a bit like an old lady-ish. it goes away once i put my rosewater spray over it. the smell is the only con and not overpowerig

avis.titre: Quite literally will never try another sunscreen
avis.texte: This is the absolute best sunscreen I have ever tried in my entire life. I have a very deep complexion and extremely oily skin, and this sunscreen has done wonders for me. The SPF is 50+, which is amazing, and the formula is extremely lightweight and not oily whatsoever. There also is no white cast on the sunscreen, no matter how much I apply. I can even get away with applying a gracious amount for a look that is GLOWY, without being OILY. I am currently running out and wouldn't even dare look elsewhere to purchase an SPF. My new holy grail.

I've been into more korean sunscreens. To me it doesnt have a smell but still smells like sunscreen. I am in a very cold climate so i wanted something year round. I dont put moisturizer on just the sunscreen because its a thick consistancy. It would work if you just want to put sunscreen on daily without having to reply. I put it on a little at a time and am careful around the eyes since its sensitive overall. I dont have acne prone skin but i do have combination and it still works since i live it a colder area. I only use this for face and hands and use stronger sunscreen if im out for vacation.
leaves skin very nice glowy super lightweight very comfortable no white cast but does irritates my eyes but way less then other spf products
It's super refreshing on the skin and hydrating. I am usually oily around the T zone but this sunscreen didn't cause any shininess yet delivered all the moisture I needed. My new fave

It's my first time trying this sunscreen but for sure I know I'll keep buying it! I was out of sunscreen and I start a search for a new one, as soon as I saw that Cosrx had one I didn't doubt on trying it because it has 50 spf plus I love all Cosrx products! New fav!

Im only a few days into trying this, but so far I'm a big fan. I have oily, acne prone skin, so I've been sticking to the more lightweight gel type sunscreens rather than creams. But this one is sooo light, after i rub it in i barely notice it. I also have a light stubble beard on my face, and this doesnt get caught at the roots on my facial hair like some other sunscreens do, so thats a big plus. There is a noticeable scent to it, I would describe it somewhere between a light woody scent, and a 'clean linens' type fresh scent. Fortunately, that combo is right up my alley, so i dont mind it, but if you are more sensitive to scents it may be off-putting.

avis.titre: Korean version of the Naturium Dew Glow(best for dryer skin)
avis.texte: This gives a very similar finish as the Naturium Dew Glow spf. Its not as heavy but the glow and finish are the same. I have combo dry skin and this is a bit too hydrating for me. Even if i used the smallest amount. She is JUICY. Maybe the best winter spf. It is also scented. Its like a fresh hotel soap scent but it doesnt bother me. This formula doesnt sting my eyes and that is a HUGE plus. The consistency is light weight and its super easy to blend. No white cast.

I got it in there summer sample bag and i wasnt too excited about using it so i bought the bag hoping the eye creams would be good. Oh my im so happy they gave me a full size because my skin felt so plump with it and i felt like it made my pores smaller and my skin slightly glowy not shiny. Ugh love im totally buying again.
This is a holy grail product for me!!! I have very acne prone skin and i use this daily with out any new break outs. I have repurchased 3 times now

I bought this about a month ago, I like it so far. It feels hydrating on my skin and wears well under makeup. I have dry skin so I appreciate that it leaves a dewy look when I dont wear makeup someone with oily skin might feel like its too greasy though. The only thing I dont like is that it does have a stronger scent in my opinion but I am pregnant so scents are highlighted these days.

avis.texte: I haven't tried this on my face yet, and I don't think I will. I tried it on the back of my hand first and immediately noticed the very strong scent. I wasn't expecting such a strong cheap perfume smell. I don't think I could deal with smelling this all day on my face. I'll probably just use it on my arms and legs. *I'll update this review after I see how well it does as an SPF cream.

This sunscreen is amazing and one I'll stick with. It's lightweight but moisturizing with no white-cast or sickly sunscreen scent, and I've found no irritation in the eyes nor the skin. Strongly recommend.

I'm very picky when it comes to sunscreen. I can't stand an oily feel, white cast, or strong sunscreen smell. This product does none of that, it's light weight and feels like lotion. In addition, it blends into the skin flawlessly and leaves it glowing. It does not smell like sunscreen, rather it smells slightly like citrus. I'm sensitive to fragrance and often I opt for fragrance free products. But this is a smell I like and can tolerate; it's not overbearing. I have acne prone, sensitive, and combination skin. This product works great for me.

I have struggled to find a spf thats moisturazing and works with my oily skin even if the texture feels a little oily when putting on but it dries leaving your skin feeling plump and not oily. Also love to use it for activies outside or working out it doesnt make my eyes burn.

I almost immediately noticed how much my skin loved the ingredients (slightly improved texture and imperfections after only a couple days) however it took over an hour to absorb/lose its greasy feeling on my face so I'm probably going to return it.

Literally is very very irritating eyes, I love but is almost impossible for me usa. The thing I can't believe is happening with this productos when almost all my skin care is COSRX I love their products less this one. Is very very irritating for eyes, will be great if they fix the formula because for that reason I don't will it buy anymore.

If I could give this sunscreen a zero I would but I have to be fair. The sunscreen is lightweight & that's why it gets the one star. My cheeks & nose turned red, got a hive on my left cheek, got pimples on both cheeks & nose. My skin is very inflamed & itchy. I wore the sunscreen for about 3 hours because I was traveling & didn't have anything else. Now I have to coddle my skin & this takes me backwards. Going to take some Benadryl next. My skin didn't hurt while wearing just had a constant tingling sensation. I would love to show you guys who have Sensitive Skin the damage but there's no pic attachment.
I really liked this sunscreen, it layers well with my other skin products. My only complaint is that towards the end of the day my eyes start to sting.

avis.texte: I enjoy this sunscreen! Feels nourishing, thick, and protective. I don't usually prefer fragrance in skin care but the smell is pleasant and non offensive. Only note is that it makes me shiny for the firat 30 min of having it one and I don't think makeup sticks well

That being said, the scent seems to dissipate after it soaks into my skin, so I will use the whole tube, but probably won't repurchase.

Why are the MAIN ACTIVE SUNBLOCK INGREDIENTS in this product not published on your website! Upon further investigation it turns out this is a physical- CHEMICAL sunblock. Very pertinent info to have when shopping for sunblock!!! Also, This would make this product not as clean as ULTA has labeled it nor reef friendly. Please fix your website info.
I have been on a hunt for the perfect SPF. It's not greasy, doesn't burn my eyes and wears beautifully!
My skin is always thirsty so this sunscreen is perfect! I apply after cosrx serums NO moisturizer because this is more than enough. Dewy and healthy is the vibe after application...
i was looking forward to this bc of the brand name and it works amazingly! it can be a bit oily but i love the after look bc it gives glass skin, and clean girl.

However i am using up the tube but just on my neck. I don't mind the fragrance. It is a bit perfumey but i am fine with it. There is no white cast because it's a chemical sunscreen not mineral. It spreads fine, but is slightly tacky.

For the price, I wanted it to be better than it was. It didnt soak into the skin like other Korean spfs ive tried, and it left an oilier finish. I also have really sensitive eyes with spf and this one was pretty irritating.

avis.auteur: Sam a Latina with oily skin

My skin is very sensitive. This is the only sunscreen that doesnt irritate my skin. If you have sensitive sking this one might work for you.

This sunscreen is just okay. It doesn't leave a white cast but that's about the only positive. The consistency is like a thick paste and once rubbed into the skin it looks greasy. It is a little on the steep side for a sunscreen, but it is WORTH it. It doesnt have a strong scent, which was a big concern of mine because im a sensitive skin girly. It spreads like butter and is SO smooth. It doesnt leave a greasy feel like a lot of sunscreen/moisturizers do. Love this. Will continue to purchase.
no white cast like with mineral sunscreens & makes my skin look & feel great!!

If you have normal to oily skin, then this will be pretty heavy. I have combo skin, and was hoping it'd at least work for the drier parts of my face, but it made me break out. It was pretty heavy and never quite dried down or absorbed. Maybe itd be workable if i hadnt broken out so badly from it, but at least it didnt have a white cast lol

avis.titre: Amazing but could be too much for oily skin
avis.texte: This is by far the best sunscreen I've ever used! It feels super light and wears perfectly under makeup. I have oily skin and it tends to make my skin look super greasy. The plus side is that my skin is protected and does not clog my pores.

My favorite sunscreen. I like the smell, blendablity, and no white cast. Its also very hydrating, you can wear it by itself or with moisturizer! It dies go on a bit sticky but you just have to keep rubbing it in and let it dry! I love it and recommend it to everyone. I love Korean brands, they are the best.

It doesn't leave a white cast, and it is easy to fully rub into skin. It looks a bit dewy, bordering on greasy when applied to my face. I've been using it consistently for about 3 weeks now and have noticed that my eyes begin to burn about 1-1.5 hours after applying. I also use it daily on my neck, chest, and arms without issue. It'd make a great body sunscreen if the tube weren't so small.

The consistency and feel of the product is really good and moisturizing. My main issue is the fragrance in it smells like "men's" aftershave. The scent did kinda wear off after like a hour but still not happy. If you aren't sensitive to fragrance or don't mind your products to be scented then I would recommend this.

It went on smoothly and left no white cast. It does feel slightly sticky but not enough to catch hair to my face. The only downside was that my face was really greasy, not dewy but greasy. I will try it again with a different moisturzer to see if it helps any. Besides the downside, it was great. I used this product under my vitamin c serum and morning moisturizer. I used about 2 full fingers amount for sunscreen. I have combination skin more on the oily side. I live in Texas(hot af) I have other sunscreens that do not leave me greasy throughtout the day.
I truly love this sunscreen! The protection it provides while looking like dewy natural skin is incredible. it does have a bit of an odd smell, but that wasn't an issue for me personally.
I am obsessed with everything sunscreen/SPF and this has become another favorite! It blends so seamlessly doesnt pill and is not greasy at all!!
Not too greasy, no harsh smell, rubs in smoothly, good price point.

avis.titre: Definitely try it, if you're considering
avis.texte: Im a sunscreen concierge and i can tell you this product is AMAZING. I love the finsh as its not too dewy and not drying at all. Also NEVER leaves white streaks. I used Supergood suncreen for my body on my trip to jamaica and it did not hold up, i ended up with burnt shoulders and back. However this CosRX suncreen did WONDERS for my skin. Not one spot of redness at all. I will continue to use it and definitely recommend trying it if youre considering it.
This sunscreen is amazing - my face tends to get red and oily throughout the day and this controls it. Last all day and leaves you looking great without makeup!

avis.titre: I miss the Aloe Vera sunscreen so much...
avis.texte: A long time ago CORSX used to have this absolutely amazing sunscreen with Aloe Vera that I swear was the holy grail of sunscreens - SPF 50, no white cast, not heavy at all, played nice with all makeup... Why they decided to replace it with this I have no idea. Not only is it more expensive, but it is heavy and honestly my least favorite part of my skincare routine. It seems to play nice with my skin and makeup for the most part, and I do have dry skin so thankfully I'm not too oily, but this is absolutely not for the oily skinned girlies - If you have oily skin, this will make your face a slip and slide. Does it get the job done? Yes. Does it play nice with my makeup and primer? Also yes. However I'm actively looking for a different sunscreen as even after using the back of my hand to sheer it out before applying it feels icky.
LOVE LOVE LOVE this sunblock-doesnot drip into eyes during humid hot days...leaves a beautiful creamy finish. has vitamin E!!

This is a hydrating and nourishing sunscreen moisturizer that provides a soft dewy glow without the greasiness that some other sunscreens will leave. I use it without moisturizer underneath as someone with combo skin. It seems to have adequate protection, as I've never burnt while using it as a very pale person. As someone with clog prone skin, this product left me with a clearer and smoother complexion after only a couple of days (though its worth noting my skin did not agree with the vitamin c in my last sunscreen). This wears wonderful underneath makeup once it is set with powder, otherwise it might not dry down completely, especially depending on the other products that youre using. It also wears well without makeup, but might be a but too glowy for some people's preference. I still find it less shiny than other popular sunscreens. The only reason it did not get 5 stars is that it is not waterproof/sweat resistant. If makeup is not properly set, it will definitely move if youre sweating or swimming. Some other reviews mention a heavy fragrance - there is certainly a perfume, but I did not find it overbearing and it dissipates quickly. As someone with sensitive eyes, this product did not burn when applied around them, but it definitely seems like this might differ from person to person. TLDR: Worth the try! Solid suncreen, great coverage, nourishing, soft-dewy glow, great for clog prone skin, some smell, but did not burn eyes. Only downside is its not waterproof or sweat-r

avis.titre: I love this product so much!
avis.texte: This is the best sunscreen I've used by far. A little goes a long way.
Simple and effective sunscreen. Love that it is lightweight and does not leave a white cast. The only thing is that it has a more of a watery consistency which isn't necessarily my favorite.
This Makes my sensitive skin itch! The fragrance is too strong. My face itches immediately
Overall a great sunscreen for the face but it does make my eyes burn throughout the day.
I love this SPF. Great for dry skin, very soft and doesn't ever pill up on me. My favorite every day sunscreen, I will always repurchase.

I love this sunscreen. It's so lightweight and makes my skin glowy. There's a slight pleasant scent to it and I have sensitive skin- it doesn't break be out. Breathable and NO WHITE CAST so this sunscreen is definitely worth it.

I really wanted to like it because usual with sensitive skin anything with Vitamin E is a holy grail, was disappointed when my skin reacted. Frangance and perfume are in this so I ended up with raw eye lids, a beauty mark reacting, and chapped lips on top of facial swelling. If fragrance isn't an issue for you was super hydrating and looked good under a primer and make up!

For my sensitive skin girls, please skip. 😅 My eyelids are raw, my skin broke out, and my lips are swollen after using for a week. I know I maybe more sensitive than others but a face sunscreen with frangrance and perfume doesn't make sense to me. Lesson learned to continue checking ingredients but for someone without sensitivity there is no white cast and leaves a beautiful canvas for make up.

I had high hopes for this product! I really wanted to love it, but it makes my skin incredibly oily- even right after application. Super sad! With that being said, I have combination skin, so it was a risk anyways. However, I don't burn while wearing it, so there's a benefit!

This is my new favorite sunscreen. I have a deep skin tone (MAC NC50) and it leaves no white cast. It creates a healthy glow that lasts all day. I have very dry skin, this may be too oily for those with oily skin.
Sunscreen does not get absorbed in the skin, sits on top and is very oily.
I really like the texture and feel of this sunscreen but the smell is so strong. Its very perfumy smelling. If you dont mind that, I think its probably perfect.

I have combo skin: oily t zone and dry everywhere else. you do not need a moisturizer when you use this because it's so moisturizing. the problem is I can feel it on my skin all day. it was heavy, slick, and never dried down all the way. I can't even imagine what it would be like in humidity.

I never wear sunscreen bc of a plethora of cons that to me outweigh the pros. But this cosrx sunscreen I promote! I've been wearing it everyday X 2 weeks. Moisturizing, a tiny fragrance but it at least smells pretty and dissipates quickly, smooth, brown girl friendly, no issues with my makeup, just luxurious feeling on AND after 2 weeks no breakouts, no comedones just beautiful skin! 🏆

I really enjoy this sunscreen i have been using it for about a year now! I have combination skin and it isnt to oily while giving that nice hydration I need. Im not sure why people are complaining about the smell it barley has any smell to it! Overall great sunscreen for dry skin!
The aloe sunscreen was better. I don't know why Cosrx changed it. This one smells like men's cologne, and I don't like it.
Light weight, and it smells good. No white cast, very good product! Love it!
This feels so nice going on, it's not dewy, doesn't rub off, great under makeup. It's soft and has a luxury feel to it with a soft scent that goes away quickly. Really love this.

Its too bad Cosrx decided to add a strong floral scent to this sunscreen. I love their snail mucin products and none of thrm have a heavy fragrance, so I bought this without checking that it was fragrance free. If it werent for the smell it would be a nice sunscreen option. It goes on pretty thick and white but dries clear. The finish is a bit dewy but not greasy. It seems to play nice under foundation too.
This seems to be a very nice face SPF, but it really smells. If it had been unscented i would probaby give it higher marks, but i cant get around the heavy floral fragrance.

Might be my favorite spf at ulta. I have tried TONS. Im always looking for a non-mineral facial sunblock for daily use that doesn't look greasy. Especially for one with such a high spf- this is great! I havent had any trouble with it getting into my eyes. For those that do, ALL so-called "chemical" sunblocks will burn if they migrate into your eyes. Try a mineral sunblock (even just around your eyes) if that is a problem.

avis.titre: It feels great but too thick for my face
avis.texte: Ive been using this for my hands & arms instead of my face since it caused my acne to worsen but it feels so cooling & moisturizing when putting it on. I would love to try a lighter version of this if it ever gets made.

This product works so well for both me and my mom. I have sensitive skin, while my mom has normal skin. The way it effortlessly blends into the skin is great. Plus, it does not have a whitecast, which makes it brown girl approved! If you have oily skin it might still work because it works so good with my makeup, but just be prepared to touch up more often.

i am extremely picky with my sunscreens and this is my honesty review of this one. it protects very well and goes on very smoothly - no white cast at all. it is very thick and oily so this is not something id recommend with oily or acne-prone skin. i wore this all day and while it did stay on while i sweat, it became more oily and made my face look like a grease ball. the octocrylene is very strong at 9% so DO NOT PUT THIS NEAR YOUR EYES. i used a sunstick around my eyes to get the coverage. this also gave a slight burning sensation on the skin, it is a bit uncomfortable and it should NOT be happening. also, it has a very strong scent as well which i am not a fan of in sunscreens as it can lead to irritation.. overrall it was an okay sunscreen and did the job of protecting my skin, but i definitely will not repurchase this one after finishing it off.
I thought it was just me with burning eyes! I don't recommend it. I would be fine the first couple of hours then my eyes would start to water then eventually burn.

Started using this recently n my skin apparently doesn't like it. My smooth face started having tiny rashes all over making it look rough. I really wanted to love it because its so lightweight n doesn't leave a white cast. Not all skin tolerate tocopherol which is a major ingredient in this product.
